title: Cancore filler protocol v1 — public records
$comment: The gateway identity (GET /v1/gateway). Records are signed by the gateway like an S→F frame (sig over GatewayMessage{keccak256(JCS(record without sig))}) but are public: no fillerId, no sentAt.

gatewayInfo.description: GET /v1/gateway: the mirror of @cancore/contracts FILLER_GATEWAYS for this environment. A taker trusts the package, and uses this to notice a rotation

maxMessageAgeMs.description: freshness bound of §3.4 in both directions: |receivedAt − sentAt| ≤ maxMessageAgeMs, and a message id is not reused within it
